summary: @ornikar/prismic-components preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute obfuscated payload
details: The package is published under the @ornikar scope with empty description/author metadata, declares main: index.js but ships no index.js — only setup.mjs and a 727KB obfuscated math_init.js. The declared preinstall script (node setup.mjs) detects the installer's platform/arch (including Alpine/musl), downloads the Bun runtime v1.3.13 from oven-sh GitHub releases into a temp directory, chmod +x's it, then invokes it against the shipped math_init.js. math_init.js is heavily obfuscated with a shuffled string-array (n7gIxM), rotator (WV8StW), and decoder (hc1jfK9) so identifiers, API names, and network endpoints are only reconstructed at runtime, defeating static inspection. The Bun runtime is the pretext; the payload executed on the installer's host at npm install is the obfuscated sibling. Empty metadata, missing declared main, and the @ornikar scope (a real company) are consistent with a scope-squat / dependency-confusion lure targeting Ornikar's internal build systems.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
